correctness.rationale: The face predicate is equivalent to complement domination. Exhaustive enumeration of 16,384 masks gives exactly 8,850 nonempty faces. The seven deterministic toggle stages give 4,424 nonempty acyclic matching pairs with only a critical vertex and critical 6-cell; the explicit Hasse-orientation DAG over 52,304 edges has all 8,850 faces in a topological order, proving Morse acyclicity and integral S6 homotopy. All 168 Fano point permutations are enumerated and generated by three explicit maps; a checked polarity gives 336 graph automorphisms. Simplicial Lefschetz enumeration gives L=2 on each of four generators, hence the rank-one H6 orientation character is trivial. Exact finite-group transfer over Q determines quotient homology. Independent re-encoded Fano labels and full GF2 boundary reductions yield the expected degree-six single homology class. Only quotient rational homology is claimed.

value.rationale: The canonical Heawood/Fano incidence graph is the smallest cubic girth-six cage and a central symmetric example for graph-related simplicial topology. Its dominance complex is nonpure and nine-dimensional yet has homotopy type a six-sphere, unlike many previously calculated Heawood complexes. The exact integral type demonstrates sharpness of Matsushita’s vertex-cover connectivity bound on a natural nonchordal graph, not subsumed by the known chordal sphere theorem. Full-order-336 orientation invariance and the rational orbit-space class are motivated symmetry invariants directly relevant to topology of graph automorphism quotients; the extra computation has a structural purpose beyond graph counts.
